component.name: Python
component.summary: Virtual environments, pip and pipx for Python projects

description.p: What a Python project needs on top of the Python that FlickOS already has: virtual environments, the headers to build extensions, pip and pipx.
Debian keeps pip out of the system's own Python on purpose, so pip works inside a virtual environment (python3 -m venv), and pipx installs command- line programs of their own.
